title: Harden the Pi feedback watch
intent: Pi no longer runs Diffect binaries found inside the reviewed repo. A loopback daemon refuses requests from web pages. Status labels got shorter.

steps.title: Only run Diffect binaries from outside the reviewed repo
steps.why: `localFile` searched upward from the extension folder and from `process.cwd()`, which is the reviewed repo. `findLocalFile` only walks up from the extension's real path. `pathCommand` runs `command -v` from your home directory and drops any result inside the workspace.

watch.text: **`existsSync` is still called but no longer imported.** `/diffect <path>`, `/diffect-review <path>` and `DIFFECT_APP_PATH` throw a ReferenceError at `diffect.ts:523`, `616` and `1025`. No tsconfig covers `integrations/pi`, so nothing caught it.
**A deleted cwd throws instead of returning null.** `realpathSync(workspaceDirectory)` sits outside the try.
**Ancestors of the extension are still trusted.** That includes a Diffect checkout under review.
**`command -v` still runs in a login shell**, so profile scripts run as before.

steps.title: Refuse rebound and cross-origin requests on a loopback daemon
steps.why: Any web page can reach 127.0.0.1:7421. When the daemon is bound to loopback, `handle` now answers 403 unless Host is a loopback address and Origin, if present, is a loopback origin. The CLI and Pi send no Origin, so they still pass.

watch.text: **`isLoopback` accepts more than before:** brackets, a trailing dot and any case. Five routes outside this change call it too (`daemon.ts:298`, `743`, `883`, `932`, `1011`).
**Odd Hosts pass after URL normalisation.** `localhost/a/..` and `localhost?` are accepted. Intended?
**A network-bound daemon is unchanged.** The check only runs when the daemon itself is on loopback.

map.via: HTTP with foreign Host or Origin

steps.title: Require application/json on request bodies
steps.why: `readJsonBody` throws unless the content type is `application/json`, and `createServer` turns that into 415. A browser can't send that type cross-origin without a preflight, which closes the forged-form POST path.

watch.text: **Every JSON POST and PUT is affected.** Nine routes call it as `readJsonBody<T>(req)`; they are the unchanged callers on this card. A client that omits the header now gets 415 on all of them.
**Clients checked:** the web app and the Pi extension send `content-type: application/json`. Nothing else was checked.

steps.title: Shorter Pi status labels
steps.why: One `watchStatusLabel` gives `Diffect ●`, `↻`, `◌` or `!`. It replaces the inline helper and four hard-coded strings.

steps.title: Tests for each boundary
steps.why: Pi watch tests cover lookup through a symlinked extension, rejecting commands inside the workspace, and the labels. Round-trip tests add `rawPost`, raw HTTP that can forge Host, Origin and content type, and check the 415 and the 403s.

watch.text: **The rebound-Host case proves only the Origin check.** Node's `fetch` replaces a custom Host header. A `rawPost` case with a foreign Host is missing.
